scripts.build:backend: cd apps/backend && npm run build && npx @vercel/ncc build dist/main.js -o dist/ncc --minify
scripts.setup: npm install && cd apps/backend && npm install && npx prisma generate && npx prisma migrate dev --name init && npm run db:seed && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../desktop && npm install
scripts.desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "cd apps/desktop && npm start"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node copy-frontend.js && node copy-backend.js && cd apps/desktop && npm run build
scripts.tauri:dev:full: npm run build:backend && concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "tauri dev"
scripts.tauri:build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && tauri build
